note: Role -> model and effort for the gpui-port-epic workflow. Override per run with /gpui-port <epic> --models role=model[:effort],... The workflow never names a model; it reads args.models[role].

implementer_hard.use: Implement step of epics with tier hard (architecture, virtual grid, models with races, data safety)

test_author.use: Tests step: ports the TypeScript behaviour cases to Rust tests, independent of the implementer

fixer_hard.use: check, parity, review and gate fixes in hard epics

fixer.use: check, parity, review and gate fixes in standard epics

clerk.use: runs job.py and collect_scope.py, reads logs, reports; never edits

parity_reviewer.use: compares Tauri and GPUI screenshots of one scenario set

scribe.use: Record step: notes, open-findings report, status
